warehouse_workflow.description: Strict master-copy pattern. Central Admin manages master products and warehouse stock. Shops request stock dispatch from linked warehouse.
flow: 1. Admin creates Master Product (master_product_id = null, is_digital = false)
2. Admin adds stock to Central Warehouse (WarehouseStock created)
3. Shop submits Stock Request from warehouse catalog
5. CloneMasterToShop creates Shop Copy Product with full attributes
6. Shop sells via Order (StockLedger records movement)
7. Shop can also sell via POS (Point of Sale)
warehouse_workflow.ledger_tracking: Every stock movement is immutably logged in StockLedger
